verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly state the Code tab lets you 'browse, edit, and download' source, and Build mode diffs are shown in-editor, supporting direct in-app code editing. However, an independent hands-on account reports that a Lovable project came with copy/paste disabled, directly undercutting the claim that generated code can be freely edited inside the builder. missing for 10: independent corroboration that in-editor code editing works unrestricted, clarification on why copy/paste was disabled in the reported case.
